formula: positive_game_unit_z * [1 - maximum_suppression * ((opponent_pregame_unit_rank - 25)/111)^2] when opposing unit rank >25; negatives and ranks 1..25 unchanged
week1: Neutral unadjusted, no pregame prior-week 2025/2026 snapshot available
measurement: Game-level per-metric z standardized from FBS games completed through each snapshot week. Passing and rushing observations weighted by exact validated eligible-play counts. n/(n+2) game-count shrinkage. Independent unit restandardization.
important: Zero-suppression control is not numerically identical to previous cumulative source-stat unit model, because per-game z normalization differs from cumulative metric normalization. Rank comparisons must use this experiment's zero-suppression control.
